The company

Fighters, squires, crew and leadership.

Roster

What is buhurt?

Medieval combat. Modern sport.

Buhurt is full-contact armoured combat fought as a real sport. Fighters wear historically based steel armour and fight with blunted steel weapons, in team melees and one-on-one duels, under international rules with marshals in the list.

The Reavers train in Red Deer and compete across Alberta and beyond. Most of us started with no armour and no combat background. Everyone begins with the basics.

How training works

Real steel

Historically based armour and blunted steel weapons, checked before anyone steps into the list.

Real contact

Strikes, shoves, clinches and takedowns, fought hard and judged under clear rules.

Real team

Melee is won together. Fighters, squires and crew all carry the result.

The fighters

Sworn to the banner

Every profile is pulled live from BuhurtOS. Records, disciplines and photos stay current as the fighters update them.

From first night to first fight

Your path into armour

No rush and no expectation to compete. You move forward when you are ready.

I

Fundamentals

Movement, balance, falling safely, conditioning and basic weapon handling.

II

Contact

Clinch work, grappling, pressure and safe striking mechanics.

III

Soft kit

Timing, tactics, teamwork and more realistic weapon work.

IV

Steel

Armoured training once your skills, conditioning and kit line up.

V

Your choice

Compete, join demos, focus on melee or duels, or simply keep training.
